newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa gasoline prices to rise by 8 cts/litre.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa gasoline prices to rise by 8 cts/litre.

text.p: South Africa's Central Energy Fund said gasoline prices would rise by eight cents per litre and diesel would rise by nine cents with effect from December 4.
Illuminating paraffin would rise by three cents per litre.

The Central Energy Fund said factors contributing to the adjustments included the sharp increase in the international prices for gasoline, diesel and illuminating paraffin. Furthermore than average rand/U.S. dollar exchange rate had also deteriorated.
From December 4 the price of 93 octane gasoline in the Gauteng area around Johannesburg will be 221.0 cents. At the coast the price goes to 211.0.

The price of diesel in Gauteng will be 222.0 cents, and 212.0 cents on the coast, while illuminating paraffin goes to 139.43 cents from 136.43 cents in Gauteng. At the coast, illuminating paraffin will be 128.43
